summary: Independent gate on the hidden Demo Mode (7-beat scripted showcase). Ran all 4 requested tests (T1 demo isolation, T2 F9-from-menu / no-demo-without-activation, T3 Esc exit-demo-with-real-save-intact, T4 normal new-game regression). All 4 PASS. Zero console errors across the T4 normal-play regression. localStorage byte-identity confirmed in both T1 (wnl_save_v1='SENTINEL_ABC', wnl_endings_seen='{"guardian":1}' — both unchanged) and T3 (wnl_save_v1='REAL_SAVE' — untouched).

T1_demo_isolation.note_on_endingKind_read: First read of gameState.endingKind returned null because the read fired between choice-click and resolveEnding on the same tick; the DOM ending-card React state (fed from the ending event) rendered correctly as guardian in the same window (see /app/test_reports/screenshots/t1_ending_guardian.png). Confirmed via a second full run where the ending-card visually reads THE GUARDIAN. No product bug.

critical_code_review_comments: DemoDirector.forceAdvance (lines 220-227) correctly no-ops when a fade is in flight (_fadeDir !== 0), preventing beat-skipping under rapid N presses. Verified in T1 by polling _fadeDir===0 between advances.

DemoDirector._enter (lines 290-307) resets _hintIdx/_hintT/_hintsDone and calls beat.setup(game) inside a try/catch — a beat that throws in setup will not brick the director. Good defensive posture for a hidden showcase.

Demo isolation: T1 seeded both wnl_save_v1 and wnl_endings_seen, ran a full 7-beat playthrough with a Guardian ending, and both keys were byte-identical to the seed after the ending card rendered. This confirms the _demoMode gating on newGame/saveNow/_doAutosave/ending in Game.js is complete.

Menus.jsx DemoHUD (lines 470-505) correctly guards the fade div with alpha>0 so no stray full-screen div sits in the DOM when the demo is idle. Pointer-events flip at alpha>0.5 is a nice touch that prevents click-eating during the darker half of a transition.

GameApp.jsx F9 handler and URL detect work end-to-end (T2 confirms both paths). The main-menu innerText contains no 'demo' substring, so the mode remains discoverable only via keybind/URL as intended.
seed_data_creation: T1 seeded localStorage.wnl_save_v1='SENTINEL_ABC' and localStorage.wnl_endings_seen='{"guardian":1}'; T3 seeded localStorage.wnl_save_v1='REAL_SAVE'. Both were cleared/verified post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo Mode is fully working and correctly isolated from the player's real save/endings-seen state. Useful helpers for future agents: (a) window.__wnl.demo.forceAdvance() is authoritative and does NOT depend on the KeyboardEvent path — prefer it over dispatching N keydowns; (b) always poll window.__wnl.demo._fadeDir===0 before firing another forceAdvance() or the second call is silently ignored; (c) beat 6 (choice) needs ~1.5s game-time (~4s wall) after startFinalChoiceSequence() before the choice buttons mount — poll for [data-testid=choice-share-btn] rather than sleeping a fixed duration; (d) reading gameState.endingKind in the same tick as clicking a choice can return null even though the ending DOM has rendered — poll or check the [data-testid=ending-kind-guardian] element instead; (e) after any full-page navigation, window.__wnl is re-created — re-poll for window.__wnl.game before evaluating anything.
